answer: WNT2+ and PEAR1+ prenatal fibroblasts expressed genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (e.g. IL1R1) and collagen deposition (e.g. POSTN). Additionally, genes associated with a pro-inflammatory fibroblast phenotype (APOE, IGFBP7 and ITM2A) were upregulated during the transition from HOXC5+ fibroblasts into PEAR1+ fibroblasts.
support_quote: Notably, WNT2+ and PEAR1+ prenatal fibroblasts expressed several genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (for example, IL1R1) and collagen deposition (for example, POSTN) (Fig. 3a,b), which are highly expressed in pathogenic fibroblasts of fibrotic skin disorders.
